summary: Inspected thys/HOL-CSP/Hiding.thy (1240 lines, 72962 bytes). This file formalizes the CSP hiding operator in the HOL-CSP shallow embedding. It contains: (1) primitive definitions (trace_hide, isInfHiddenRun, div_hide) with supporting lemmas; (2) the main Hiding operator via lift_definition with full proof obligations establishing it as a valid process; (3) projection lemmas for failures, divergences, and traces (F_Hiding, D_Hiding, T_Hiding); (4) multiple optimized divergence characterizations (div_hide_optimized, div_hide_seqRun) with equivalence proofs; (5) continuity proofs (mono_Hiding, chain_Hiding, div_Hiding_lub, Cont_Hiding_prem, Hiding_cont); (6) a general Koenig's Lemma for infinite prefix-closed sets. Every section contains formal definitions, lemma/theorem statements, and complete Isabelle proofs. This is core formal mathematics for CSP process algebra.
